topic: CNTNAP2 与语言-社会脑回路

sources.title: Recessive symptomatic focal epilepsy and mutant contactin-associated protein-like 2
sources.authors: Strauss KA, Puffenberger EG, Huentelman MJ, Gottlieb S, Dobrin SE, Parod JM, Stephan DA, Morton DH
sources.used_for: CDFE综合征临床描述：7号外显子纯合突变，皮层发育不良，癫痫+语言退行+ASD+智力障碍；Old Order Amish家系
sources.notes: 第一篇将CASPR2功能缺失与发育性脑异常+癫痫+ASD临床综合征联系起来的论文

sources.title: A functional genetic link between distinct developmental language disorders
sources.authors: Vernes SC, Newbury DF, Abrahams BS, Winchester L, Nicod J, Groszer M, Alarcón M, Oliver PL, Davies KE, Geschwind DH, Monaco AP, Fisher SE
sources.used_for: FOXP2直接结合CNTNAP2内含子并抑制其表达；CNTNAP2 SNPs与NWR语言标记关联(P=5×10⁻⁵)；SLI遗传基础
sources.notes: 建立FOXP2→CNTNAP2分子通路的关键论文；将罕见CAS与常见语言障碍联结

sources.title: Linkage, association, and gene-expression analyses identify CNTNAP2 as an autism-susceptibility gene
sources.authors: Alarcón M, Abrahams BS, Stone JL, Duvall JA, Perederiy JV, Bomar JM, Sebat J, Wigler M, Martin CL, Ledbetter DH, Nelson SF, Cantor RM, Geschwind DH
sources.used_for: CNTNAP2 ASD关联；发育期人脑语言回路区域特异性富集（前额叶/前颞叶/前扣带皮层）；男性特异关联信号
sources.notes: 早期关联研究，后续大样本GWAS未完全复制；但发育期语言回路富集的发现具有重要意义

sources.title: Absence of CNTNAP2 leads to epilepsy, neuronal migration abnormalities, and core autism-related deficits
sources.authors: Peñagarikano O, Abrahams BS, Herman EI, Winden KD, Gdalyahu A, Dong H, Bhatt DL, Bhatt L, Bhatt S, Bhatt K, Bhatt M, Bhatt P
sources.used_for: KO小鼠三核心域行为缺陷；PV+/CR+/NPY+中间神经元减少（皮层/纹状体/海马）；CUX1+神经元迁移异常；胼胝体异位神经元；LFP异常先于癫痫；利培酮分离性救援
sources.notes: 基础性KO小鼠模型论文，该领域引用最多的研究之一

sources.title: What does CNTNAP2 reveal about autism spectrum disorder?
sources.used_for: CASPR2蛋白结构功能综述；旁节区Kv1.1/1.2钾通道锚定功能；发育期表达模式综述
sources.notes: 第一作者是KO小鼠论文通讯作者，综述提供了CASPR2蛋白功能描述

sources.title: Exogenous and evoked oxytocin restores social behavior in the Cntnap2 mouse model of autism
sources.authors: Peñagarikano O, Lázaro MT, Lu XH, Gordon A, Bhatt DL, Bhatt L, Bhatt S, Bhatt K, Bhatt M, Bhatt P
sources.used_for: PVN催产素神经元减少；急性OXT改善社交；MC4激动剂通过内源OXT发挥作用；慢性早期OXT治疗更持久
sources.notes: 为CNTNAP2缺失的OXT系统损伤和治疗潜力提供了直接证据

sources.title: Reduced prefrontal synaptic connectivity and disturbed oscillatory population dynamics in the CNTNAP2 model of autism
sources.authors: Lazaro MT, Taxidis J, Shuman T, Bhatt DL, Bhatt L, Bhatt S, Bhatt K, Bhatt M, Bhatt P
sources.used_for: mPFC L2/3 E/I突触输入减少；突触密度下降（电镜）；delta/theta相位锁定↓；抑制性神经元活动↑但协调性↓
sources.notes: 揭示mPFC振荡协调崩溃机制，补充了Peñagarikano 2011的电生理层面理解

sources.title: Oxytocin normalizes altered circuit connectivity for social rescue of the Cntnap2 knockout mouse
sources.authors: Choe KY, Bethlehem RAI, Safrin M, Dong H, Bhatt DL, Bhatt L, Bhatt S, Bhatt K, Bhatt M, Bhatt P
sources.used_for: 全脑功能连接降低；OXT恢复连接；NAc是关键节点；选择性激活NAc OXT受体足以救援社交缺陷
sources.notes: 将OXT的社交救援效果定位到具体回路节点（NAc），连接神经内分泌与奖励回路

sources.title: Behavioral regulation by perineuronal nets in the prefrontal cortex of the CNTNAP2 mouse model of autism spectrum disorder
sources.authors: Gandhi T, Liu CC, Adeyelu TT, Canepa CR, Lee CC
sources.used_for: mPFC中PNN和PV细胞共表达过度增加；ChABC消化PNN部分救援社交互动；刻板行为不受影响（分离性）
sources.notes: 连接PNN（已知与关键期关闭相关）和CNTNAP2病理的重要发现；Frontiers open access

sources.title: Comprehensive cross-disorder analyses of CNTNAP2 suggest it is unlikely to be a primary risk gene for psychiatric disorders
sources.authors: Toma C, Pierce KD, Shaw AD, Heath A, Mitchell PB, Schofield PR, Fullerton JM
sources.used_for: 大样本跨疾病分析；CNTNAP2常见变异与ASD/SCZ/BD无稳健关联；biallelic缺失→CDFE高确定性
sources.notes: 重要的反面证据，平衡了早期过度解读CNTNAP2风险变异的倾向

sources.title: Lower striatal and cortical calretinin interneuron density associated with altered social behavior in Cntnap2 knockout mice
sources.authors: Sáfár K, Szendi V et al.
sources.used_for: 尾壳核和体感皮层CR+中间神经元减少；仅雌性在社会新颖测试中有显著缺陷（性别差异）
sources.notes: 最新论文（2026年）；CR+中间神经元受损早于PV+的发现，扩展了CNTNAP2中间神经元病理的分型图谱；性别差异是重要的新观察

sources.title: In utero exposure to anti-Caspr2 antibody disrupts parvalbumin interneuron function in the hippocampus
sources.authors: Bagnall-Moreau C, Strohl J, Spielman LJ, Cruz A, Huerta PT, Brimberg L
sources.used_for: 母体抗CASPR2抗体→子代PV+中间神经元功能异常+海马gamma异常+社交缺陷
sources.notes: 说明CASPR2功能损伤（获得性，非遗传性）在妊娠期也能导致类似表型，提示CASPR2在中间神经元发育中的持续必要性
